Ang sitwasyon

The situation
Dan has had a cough for some time and is embarrassed to ask at the health centre.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamainam na gagawin ng BHW sa sitwasyong ito?

display_fil:
Halimbawa
Sa kathang-isip na kasong ito, ginamit ni Mira ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay bago sumagot.
display_en:
Worked example
In this fictional case, Mira checks the current local guide before responding.
narration_fil: Sa kathang-isip na kasong ito, ginamit ni Mira ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay bago sumagot. Ito ang ipinakita niya sa observer: Kausapin si Dan nang pribado, ipaliwanag ang kasalukuyang TB assessment route, at sundin ang awtorisadong follow-up role.
narration_en: In this fictional case, Mira checks the current local guide before responding. The observer sees that she uses non-stigmatizing language, refers through the verified route, and records only authorized facts.

display_fil:
Saklaw at kaligtasan
Iwasan ang ganitong kilos: Ihayag sa kapitbahay na may TB si Dan kahit wala pang pagsusuri.
display_en:
Scope and safety
Avoid this action: Tell neighbors Dan has TB without assessment.
narration_fil: Iwasan ang ganitong kilos: Ihayag sa kapitbahay na may TB si Dan kahit wala pang pagsusuri. Kung hindi tiyak ang susunod na hakbang, humingi ng gabay sa midwife o aprubadong lokal na protocol.
narration_en: Avoid this action: Tell neighbors Dan has TB without assessment. If the next step is uncertain, consult the midwife or approved local protocol.

options.en: Uses non-stigmatizing language, refers through the verified route, and records only authorized facts.

Gawin sa trabaho

display_en:
Use this at work
At the next supervised practice, use this fictional case.
narration_fil: Sa susunod na pinangangasiwaang pagsasanay, gamitin ang kathang-isip na kasong ito. Ipasuri ang kilos sa observer sheet at ulitin ang hakbang na kailangang ayusin.
narration_en: At the next supervised practice, use this fictional case. Ask the observer to score the action on the observer sheet, then repeat the step that needs correction.
